name: Azeroth Companion
title: Party Architect — Player Utility Expansion
features: New five-player Party Architect with selectable World of Warcraft classes and specializations, including Devourer Demon Hunter
Party role validation highlights standard one-tank, one-healer, three-damage coverage and selected class-wide utility examples
Copy a group summary or export/import a portable party JSON for coordination with friends
Per-character weekly activity tracker for dungeons, raids, and world activities with custom player-selected targets
Character selector reads existing Genesis profiles while preserving every prior character, build, route, collection, and gear note
Quick Reference gives direct links to official Warcraft resources and established external tools
Dedicated responsive Party Architect and Weekly Vault panels for desktop and iPhone; no game-client automation
Independent Azeroth release versioning, validation and Discord announcement behavior remain unchanged
